text:
sophia: quick flag — after rolling metering-client v2 to a subset of edge proxies (EU-2 canary) invoice previews are drifting for a handful of tenants. looks like attribution is missing for some requests. canary is 10% so small blast radius but noticeable in preview delta.

matt: what changed in v2? header names? batching?

sophia: header rename. v1 sent `x-tenant-id` and fell back to `tenant`. v2 standardizes on `x-routed-tenant` and dropped the fallback. ingestion aggregator still reads `x-tenant-id` in the fast path. result: some routed requests are landing un-attributed -> preview shows credit undercounts.

billing-sre: that would do it. our ingest quick-path is optimizing for `x-tenant-id` (legacy). if header absent it tags as unknown and later replays sometimes, but invoice preview only uses fast-path snapshot.

jordan: is this limited to EU-2 canary? or rolled elsewhere?

sophia: only EU-2 and a couple of edge nodes in APAC where v2 flip happened yesterday. global hosted and dedicated unaffected.

anya: quick mitigation: map `x-routed-tenant` -> `x-tenant-id` at the proxy edge so aggregator sees legacy header. can do as a small lua/nginx hook. e.g.

```lua
-- pseudo-edge hook
local rt = ngx.req.get_headers()["x-routed-tenant"]
if rt and not ngx.req.get_headers()["x-tenant-id"] then
  ngx.req.set_header("x-tenant-id", rt)
end
```

sophia: that seems safest for a short window while we update aggregator code. can we patch EU-2 now and roll to the two APAC nodes?

deploy-bot: canary rollout triggered: metering-client v2 -> edge-proxy-eu-2 (10%) by sophia.

billing-sre: when you patch, please also check dedupe logic. if both headers appear (old + new) the dedupe timestamp logic could create double events in the replay path. add an idempotency check or prefer `x-tenant-id` if present.

matt: also file a small SDK migration note. folks integrating with edge-client might rely on fallback `tenant` header. doc update and changelog needed.

anya: ingest-side quick patch is trivial. i'll open a hotfix PR for the edge hook and add unit tests to ensure we don't overwrite existing `x-tenant-id` if present. test plan: canary 10% -> monitor preview delta for 5m -> 100% in 30m if stable.

sophia: ack. i'll deploy the edge-hook canary now. can someone run invoice-preview after canary and post results? @billing-sre?

billing-sre: i'll run preview job and post a diff once the canary is live. also adding a short query to find any rows tagged `tenant = 'unknown' AND source_edge = 'eu-2'` so we can track regressions.

matt: long-term we should update aggregator to accept both headers (configurable) and add a migration flag so we don't rely on edge transforms.

deploy-bot: deployment: edge-proxy-hook-pr-438 merged; canary rollout started at 4623460200 (10%).

sophia: thanks. ping me if preview still shows a gap after the canary. I'll hold on full rollout until we get green. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks for the quick triage everyone. once stable let's add a postmortem blurb to the docs so customers know why preview drift happened.

anya: i'll add unit/integration tests to the ingest repo and link the PR in here when ready.

billing-sre: preview diff after 2m: gap reduced ~95% for the tenants we saw. running full preview now.

sophia: nice. schedule for full roll at +30m unless any further regressions.

matt: created GH issue to track SDK changelog and console migration note: rwinf/metering#1124

sophia: closing loop: after full roll we'll run a backfill for any `unknown` attributions and mark invoices as reconciled. will coordinate with finance ops.

anya: PR links: edge hook -> https://github.com/rwinf/edge-proxy/pull/438; ingest tests -> https://github.com/rwinf/ingest/pull/912

billing-sre: all good on preview after full rollout. leaving notes for ops-runbook.

sophia: thanks everyone, great triage.
